title_en: Chinese Humor (8/20): Ruled by the Cat
note_en: 不是A，而是B means "not A, but B": it rejects A and puts B in its place. 家里真正的主人根本不是自己，而是这只高高在上的猫主子 "the real master of the house is not him at all, but this lordly cat." 根本 ("at all") strengthens the denial. Don't mix it up with 不是A，就是B, which means "either A or B."
